top_signals.title: Spain, France Inflation Data Boost Case for ECB Rate Hike
top_signals.summary: Spanish inflation surged to more than double the European Central Bank’s 2% target while France’s reading exceeded expectations, strengthening the case for an increase in interest rates next month. Paul Hollingsworth, head of developed market economics at BNP Paribas, says an ECB rate hike is now "all but nailed on." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Longer wells boost Permian crude oil and natural gas production
top_signals.summary: Well operators in the Permian region of western Texas and eastern New Mexico are getting more oil and gas out of the ground by drilling longer, horizontal wells and increasingly incorporating so-called super-lateral wells that exceed 15,000 feet.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Why Japan’s centrist opposition parties can’t get along with one another
top_signals.summary: The Centrist Reform Alliance was supposed to have merged by now with the remaining elements of the Constitutional Democratic Party of Japan and Komeito.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
